A typed SSA value (edge) in the IR graph.

detaileddescription.para: Each Value is produced by exactly one Node (its node()) and may be consumed by zero or more nodes, tracked via uses(). The value carries optional type information: ONNX element type (elemType()) and shape (sizes()).
Value objects are owned by their Graph; do not delete them manually.
